title: Power-Outage Checklist Recovery Time
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type="grid_outage"
| stats count as outages, avg(recovery_minutes) as avg_recovery_min, max(recovery_minutes) as worst_recovery_min by circuit
| sort - worst_recovery_min
description: Tracks how long each power-outage incident takes to recover, including checklist-driven recovery tasks.
value: Recovery-time data tells you whether backup power, flashlight placement, and outage procedures are genuinely working.
implementation: Forward Home Assistant outage and recovery markers into Splunk and attach a `recovery_minutes` field once the incident closes.
visualization: Bar chart of average and worst recovery time by circuit.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It spots how long it takes to get things back to normal after the power goes out.
